prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Project Zomboid B42 mech concept image, phase 1 ONLY, a concept illustration not an actual 3D model.
Create a completely original military humanoid walking weapon approximately 15 meters tall designed for deployment suspended from a formation of helicopters. No source images, no downloaded assets. DO NOT copy or resemble any named film/game mech. Industrial heavy equipment aesthetics. Basic material matte black armor plates, dark charcoal gray metal joints and seams. Orange emission only at circular chest reactor core, wide horizontal visor, and a few thin inset lines between armor plates.
Mandatory: a round glowing orange reactor dead center chest; flat low-profile helmet head containing fictional two-person cockpit, wide narrow horizontal orange visor; wide shoulders and thick arms; discrete visible booster housings mounted BEHIND BOTH elbows to accelerate punching, separate from cannon; a transformable RIGHT forearm with obvious two longitudinal hinged armor leaves, wrist retracting rail and central emitter core, in STOWED FIST mode; tank-weight substantial lower body and large broad feet; ONE thick steel helicopter cable lifting eye on TOP of EACH shoulder, 2 total, clearly visible and open. Do not add helicopters or cables to scene. Tiny invented equipment numbers and geometric hazard icons allowed, no real military, company, game or film text/logos. No recognizable IP silhouettes.
Design explicitly suitable for later <15,000 triangles: broad simple planar armor, chunky box or wedge masses, short cylinders, few large joint elements, limited subpanels; NO intricate greeble networks, fine pipes, mesh grilles or ornamental rivets. Clean digital industrial concept illustration, modeled form readable, modest edge shading, not photoreal movie still.
Composition: ONE single full-body FRONT elevation view, standing neutral with feet apart, arms slightly clear of torso, fists relaxed; head to soles fully visible, no cropping, no second mech, no inset diagrams. Portrait 2:3 canvas, light warm gray blank background, neutral studio light plus subtle orange emission, clear outline, soft ground shadow. On the ground next to one foot draw exactly one plain 1.8 m adult human silhouette, correctly at 12% of mech height from head to foot on the SAME ground plane; silhouette top reaches just above ankle, far below knee. Simple outer annotation '15 m' beside mech and '1.8 m' beside silhouette. Label only concept letter and 'FRONT' in a small clean corner label. All other main markings abstract. Keep the illustration mechanically legible and original.
Variant: A: heavily armored tank-type brawler. Very broad square slab shoulders, squat wide torso, heavy forearms and large block fists, boxy layered hip armor, thick wide thighs and shin guards, flat broad squared feet. Low center of gravity, stocky massively planted silhouette. Helmet a short flat trapezoidal block set back between shoulders; lower face is a solid stepped armor jaw, not a familiar film helmet. Minimal small wear; matte black dominates.
Exact corner text: 'A / FRONT'.
prompts.scale_edit: Edit this original concept FRONT image with ONE targeted scale correction. Keep EXACTLY the same mech, same pose, same silhouette, armor, helmet, mechanical details, lighting and composition. Keep label 'A / FRONT'. ONLY correct the ground-level human size and measurement annotations. Enlarge existing human silhouette from approximately 115px to approximately 157px tall, i.e. 12% of the mech's approx 1300px head-to-sole height. Keep human on SAME ground plane beside foot, unadorned simple black adult silhouette. Human top should reach approximately lower shin, far below knee. Keep '1.8 m' by human. Correct machine '15 m' measurement line to run from TOP OF HELMET to SOLES, not to ankle and not to shoulder lifting ring. Do not change any other image element. NO new assets, no second mech.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Use attached original generated A front view as the sole design reference. Create a NEW single full-body THREE-QUARTER view image of the EXACT SAME ORIGINAL mech, not another concept and not a real 3D deliverable. Preserve helmet, armor shapes, shoulder lifting eyes, chest core, material colors, variant proportions and wear patterns. Rotate camera to see the machine's anatomical RIGHT side prominently (the same forearm on viewer's left in front reference), about 35 degrees from front; show face and chest clearly. Camera at torso height, entire machine head to soles fully visible, portrait 2:3, light gray blank studio backdrop. Mech standing stable, both feet firmly grounded, legs and feet fully visible. Its RIGHT forearm is now in PLASMA CANNON MODE: fist retracts into wrist recess, two broad forearm armor leaves hinge outward/upward from the forearm, expose a SHORT thick polygonal cannon sleeve with round ORANGE plasma emitter replacing fist at wrist end. The cannon is integrated in the forearm, NOT a separate held gun. Aim right forearm a little forward and downward, so cannon muzzle and opened hinged plates are visible from this angle. LEFT hand stays fist. The separate punch booster at BACK of EACH elbow must be visible as an independent cylindrical exhaust housing facing back; do not confuse it with the wrist cannon. TWO intact cable lifting eyes on TOP of shoulders.
Matte black broad simple panels, charcoal joints and orange chest/visor/slender seam light preserved. Original military heavy machinery, no film/game/company logos, tiny invented number/geometric hazard markings only. Main shapes achievable under 15,000 triangles, small wear drawn as texture rather than geometry. No weapon discharge, no smoke, no action pose. EXACT scale: single unadorned adult human silhouette at the same ground plane next to foot, height EXACTLY 0.12 times mech head-to-sole image height (e.g. 156 px if mech is 1300 px), no perspective-shrinking. Label '1.8 m' beside human and '15 m' beside machine, no falsely short measurement line. Label 'A / 3-4 VIEW' small in corner. No other views or diagrams. Do not crop.
prompts.scale_edit: Precise image edit. ONLY make the small silhouette at lower right 40% TALLER AND 40% WIDER than it is in this image, anchored at its existing sole position on the ground, so the human appears 1.8m tall relative to this 15m mech. The humanoid mech head-to-sole span is ~1300px, human should be ~156px tall. Keep the human completely a plain black silhouette. Move the '1.8 m' text slightly as necessary to fit the larger silhouette and align its short height marker with new silhouette. The '15 m' tall measurement line should end at the ground, not the ankle, and start at the helmet. Preserve ALL pixels of the MECH unchanged: do not modify pose, armor, head, materials, number markings, cannon, shoulder eyes, feet, glow, shadows or camera. Keep existing corner title and blank gray backdrop. Do not redesign anything.
